::: {.why}
Clipping is the most direct application of yesterday's result, and it gives you a cleaning method whose only parameter comes from theory rather than from a sweep.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Build a cleaned covariance estimator by eigenvalue clipping and confirm it is positive definite with the trace preserved.
- Report the out-of-sample realised risk of a minimum-variance portfolio under the sample and the cleaned matrix.

::: {.task}

Report predicted and realised for both.
